svg.aria-label: Record sleeve. Front: a single mark, raw dots resolving into a solid disc, wrapped by a blue obi band crowded with credits: Martin Doré, data scientist, machine learning, data engineering, AI agents, open to work CDI or freelance. Back: track list. A1 Débrief AI Studio, voice in, video out, 120 frames in about 7 seconds. A2 Dairy Dashboard, a farmer runs the study alone, live demo. B1 Match Analysis, ball possession frame by frame, YOLOv8. B2 Fuel Model, a prediction behind a Flask API, RMSE 2.31.
